Back to school Nicolette Jones attends a school reunion and finds that times change, people do not (1) When Anne Bechar set out to find the 80 or so women – myself included – who were at Leeds Girls’ High School with her until 1979, it was, she admits, because she had lots of good news she wanted to tell them. ‘I wasn’t very academic at school, and I felt I was a nobody,’ she says. “Now I have lived for years in Paris and eight years in the Middle East, I have a family and I run a successful business. I feel that I am somebody.” (2) Anne’s detective work resulted in the tracking-down of all but a dozen of our exclassmates. Then we received our invitations and 44 of us, astonished by the realization that we had been old girls for 20 years, agreed to show up for a lunch. Another 20 sent news, good wishes and apologies. (3) So, once we’d had our hair done – and wondering whether we would recognize each other – we assembled in a dining hall that made us think of cabbage and sponge pudding. By the end of lunch it could have been 20 years ago; it was like a bad episode of soap opera in which everything that had happened since was a dream. (4) It was not simply that in our own eyes we were unchanged. It was that we had gone back to the roles of two decades ago. Bryony, our head girl, who is now a doctor, asked kind questions with exactly the grace towards younger girls that made her popular then. Anne was told off by her friend Ruth for talking down to her, exactly as she had done at school. I showed off. We had become 14-year-olds in 37year-old bodies. (5) The school authorities, who had arranged a tour of new buildings for us, found us uncooperative. We didn’t want to see the new language labs and the new music block. We all wanted to see desks we sat at, we all walked along the corridors we had regularly raced down and talked in, and remembered. We wanted to meet the ghosts of our childhood selves. (6) We were amazed, though, at the well-stocked careers room. In our day, careers advice was a teacher who mostly suggested nursing and secretarial work. Her limited imagination had not had much effect. Among us were doctors, lawyers, accountants, pharmacists and laboratory technicians. Diane, who was enough of a rebel at school to break the rules about wearing make-up, is now a beautician. Mandy is now a school governor. And I became a journalist. Ответ:

Decide if each sentence 1–5 is correct or incorrect. If it is correct, select YES. If it is not correct, select NO. (Pause 20 seconds) Now we are ready to start. Welcome to Sightseeing Tours in Moscow! Are you just planning your trip to Moscow or have you already arrived in the beautiful Russian capital and are wondering where to start exploring it? A Hop-on, Hop-off Bus tour will be your best choice. Buy a 48 or 72-hour ticket and hop on and off our buses as many times as you want during those 2 or 3 days to take a closer look at the capital’s old churches, museums or just to take a walk. On board the bus, you will enjoy the beautiful sights out of the window, while learning about the history of Moscow either from headphones or a live guide. Our headphone guide is available in 10 different languages. There are 3 bus routes that you can choose from: Red, Green and Orange. Two of them start in the centre of Moscow, and one of them starts at the Museum of Cosmonautics. Each route has about 15 stops near the most interesting places of Moscow that you might want to spend more time on. Our Green Route includes a 1-hour cruise on board the river boat. From the Moskva River, you will see the Moscow Kremlin, Gorky Park, Christ the Saviour Cathedral and many other sights from a completely different perspective. All our Routes run from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Red Route buses run every 15 minutes; while Orange and Green Route buses run every 30 minutes. If you decide not to get off the bus and do a full circle, the Red Route tour will take 1 hour to complete; while Orange and Green Route tours will last 2 hours each. If you decide to join us, don’t forget to bring your passport or ID card with you. Pets and smoking are not allowed on the tour. For more information and prices, check out our website. Hope to see you soon! Until then – good-bye! Now you have 20 seconds to fulfil the task. (Pause 20 seconds) Now listen to the text again. (The recording is repeated) Now you have 15 seconds to check your answers. (Pause 15 seconds) This is the end of the Listening part.
